create_UCF_dataset_train: create a UCF dataset instance using the train subset for UCF-101 action recognition training
create_UCF_dataset_test: create a UCF dataset instance using the test subset for UCF-101 action recognition evaluation
customize_UCF_clip_duration: customize the UCF dataset video clip duration and fps parameters for different sampling rates
enable_UCF_labels: enable label return in the UCF dataset by setting return_labels to True for supervised learning
configure_UCF_clips_per_video: configure the number of clips sampled per video in the UCF dataset for data augmentation
